LOADSPACE CAPACITY
The loadspace in Range Rover Evoque is a functional and yet
stylishly appointed space. All models contain ample luggage room
for the perfect weekend getaway or that last minute shopping trip.
The Coupe and Five-door body styles offer flexible seating which can
be easily configured with the rear 60:40 split seating arrangement,
or for maximum loadspace, the rear seats can be folded down to
fit around you and your trip. When the rear seats are upright this
delivers a healthy loadspace of 19.4 cu.ft for the Coupe or 20.3 cu.ft
on the Five-door.
The Convertible tailgate has been delivered to allow easy access to
the loadspace and even has an optional ski hatch which also doubles
as an arm rest. The loadspace capacity, 8.9 cu.ft, remains unchanged
regardless of the roof position and is able to accommodate a standard
golf bag.
